name: RHD prophylaxis overdue
description: BPG injection past due: ACT Core's next due date for an injection regimen has passed
criteria: SELECT pat.patient_id FROM patient pat JOIN person p ON p.person_id = pat.patient_id AND p.voided = 0 AND p.dead = 0 JOIN actcore_prophylaxis_adherence a ON a.patient_id = pat.patient_id WHERE pat.voided = 0 AND a.injection_interval_days > 0 AND a.next_due < CURDATE() AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM patient_program pp JOIN program pr ON pr.program_id = pp.program_id AND pr.uuid = '7d73e143-a550-5a9d-aecd-dd771add098d' WHERE pp.patient_id = pat.patient_id AND pp.voided = 0 AND pp.date_completed IS NULL)

name: RHD lost to follow-up
description: No RHD Consultation Visit or Consultation Update form and no prophylaxis record for 210 days (7 months) in a patient with a prescription. Mirrors ACT 2.0 Needs Prophylaxis Data Red.
criteria: SELECT pat.patient_id FROM patient pat JOIN (SELECT e.patient_id, MAX(e.encounter_datetime) AS last_consult FROM encounter e JOIN form f ON f.form_id = e.form_id WHERE f.uuid IN ('4b063fc7-996f-3001-8500-8940e201be8f', '72ebc67c-f221-3ca2-9494-f5b19ecc60d5') AND e.voided = 0 GROUP BY e.patient_id) con ON con.patient_id = pat.patient_id JOIN (SELECT o.person_id, MAX(o.value_datetime) AS last_injection FROM obs o JOIN concept c ON c.concept_id = o.concept_id WHERE c.uuid = '183fb30e-b861-5b7c-806f-7118a40f2b51' AND o.voided = 0 GROUP BY o.person_id) inj ON inj.person_id = pat.patient_id JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT o.person_id FROM obs o JOIN concept q ON q.concept_id = o.concept_id WHERE q.uuid = '668e0221-8b41-5669-9ad8-78e193d42494' AND o.voided = 0 AND o.value_coded IS NOT NULL) rx ON rx.person_id = pat.patient_id WHERE pat.voided = 0 AND DATE(con.last_consult) < DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 210 DAY) AND DATE(inj.last_injection) < DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 210 DAY)
message: Lost to follow-up: no data for 7 months

criteria: SELECT pat.patient_id FROM patient pat JOIN (SELECT e.patient_id, MAX(e.encounter_datetime) AS last_consult FROM encounter e JOIN form f ON f.form_id = e.form_id WHERE f.uuid IN ('4b063fc7-996f-3001-8500-8940e201be8f', '72ebc67c-f221-3ca2-9494-f5b19ecc60d5') AND e.voided = 0 GROUP BY e.patient_id) con ON con.patient_id = pat.patient_id JOIN (SELECT o.person_id, MAX(o.value_datetime) AS last_injection FROM obs o JOIN concept c ON c.concept_id = o.concept_id WHERE c.uuid = '183fb30e-b861-5b7c-806f-7118a40f2b51' AND o.voided = 0 GROUP BY o.person_id) inj ON inj.person_id = pat.patient_id JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT o.person_id FROM obs o JOIN concept q ON q.concept_id = o.concept_id WHERE q.uuid = '668e0221-8b41-5669-9ad8-78e193d42494' AND o.voided = 0 AND o.value_coded IS NOT NULL) rx ON rx.person_id = pat.patient_id WHERE pat.voided = 0 AND DATE(con.last_consult) < DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 150 DAY) AND DATE(inj.last_injection) < DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 150 DAY) AND NOT (DATE(con.last_consult) < DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 210 DAY) AND DATE(inj.last_injection) < DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 210 DAY))
